set.body: PRD C-7, C-8. viaSmoothing lifts Compare[Mass,Mass,S] to Compare[Scanpath,Scanpath,S]. The map-vs-points slot ships in v1.0 as an interface with at least one instance — it is the slot eyesim structurally lacks and the foundation of the whole saliency metric family.
set.title: viaSmoothing lift and the map-vs-points interface
